from typing import Protocol, Optional, List, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime


class DataRecord(Protocol):
    """Minimal interface that all parsed data records must implement."""
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a serializable dictionary representation."""
        ...


class UserRecord:
    """Minimal, serializable user record for decoupled data transfer."""
    
    __slots__ = (
        'id', 'nickname', 'gender', 'location', 'birthday', 'description',
        'verified_reason', 'talent', 'education', 'work', 'weibo_num',
        'following', 'followers'
    )
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        id: str = '',
        nickname: str = '',
        gender: str = '',
        location: str = '',
        birthday: str = '',
        description: str = '',
        verified_reason: str = '',
        talent: str = '',
        education: str = '',
        work: str = '',
        weibo_num: int = 0,
        following: int = 0,
        followers: int = 0
    ):
        self.id = id
        self.nickname = nickname
        self.gender = gender
        self.location = location
        self.birthday = birthday
        self.description = description
        self.verified_reason = verified_reason
        self.talent = talent
        self.education = education
        self.work = work
        self.weibo_num = weibo_num
        self.following = following
        self.followers = followers
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'nickname': self.nickname,
            'gender': self.gender,
            'location': self.location,
            'birthday': self.birthday,
            'description': self.description,
            'verified_reason': self.verified_reason,
            'talent': self.talent,
            'education': self.education,
            'work': self.work,
            'weibo_num': self.weibo_num,
            'following': self.following,
            'followers': self.followers
        }


class WeiboRecord:
    """Minimal, serializable微博 record for decoupled data transfer."""
    
    __slots__ = (
        'id', 'user_id', 'content', 'article_url', 'original_pictures',
        'retweet_pictures', 'original', 'video_url', 'original_pictures_list',
        'retweet_pictures_list', 'media', 'publish_place', 'publish_time',
        'publish_tool', 'up_num', 'retweet_num', 'comment_num'
    )
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        id: str = '',
        user_id: str = '',
        content: str = '',
        article_url: str = '',
        original_pictures: str = '',
        retweet_pictures: str = '',
        original: bool = True,
        video_url: str = '',
        original_pictures_list: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        retweet_pictures_list: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        media: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        publish_place: str = '',
        publish_time: str = '',
        publish_tool: str = '',
        up_num: int = 0,
        retweet_num: int = 0,
        comment_num: int = 0
    ):
        self.id = id
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.content = content
        self.article_url = article_url
        self.original_pictures = original_pictures
        self.retweet_pictures = retweet_pictures
        self.original = original
        self.video_url = video_url
        self.original_pictures_list = original_pictures_list or []
        self.retweet_pictures_list = retweet_pictures_list or []
        self.media = media or {}
        self.publish_place = publish_place
        self.publish_time = publish_time
        self.publish_tool = publish_tool
        self.up_num = up_num
        self.retweet_num = retweet_num
        self.comment_num = comment_num
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'user_id': self.user_id,
            'content': self.content,
            'article_url': self.article_url,
            'original_pictures': self.original_pictures,
            'retweet_pictures': self.retweet_pictures,
            'original': self.original,
            'video_url': self.video_url,
            'original_pictures_list': self.original_pictures_list,
            'retweet_pictures_list': self.retweet_pictures_list,
            'media': self.media,
            'publish_place': self.publish_place,
            'publish_time': self.publish_time,
            'publish_tool': self.publish_tool,
            'up_num': self.up_num,
            'retweet_num': self.retweet_num,
            'comment_num': self.comment_num
        }
